conf.description: MOVEit Automation file activity, jdbc-sql: stats-table Database Collector rows shaped to ECS + moveit.automation.*, same duration/outcome handling as the api-pull sibling.

conf.comment: moveit-mft / automation-transfers / jdbc-sql: direct read of MOVEit Automation's 'stats' table (Database Collector, checkpointed on ID, excludes StatusCode 5000/5010 in the collector query same as the REST report default). Same per-file grain as the api-pull sibling but already typed, so only ECS shaping is needed. Shares the SourceDuration/DestDuration-to-nanoseconds conversion and ErrCode->event.outcome mapping per recommendations.direct.cribl, plus the table-only columns the REST report omits (Node, NominalStart, SourceStamp, DestFilenameOnly, DestFileID). TaskName is NOT recovered here - the map notes it requires a taskruns join on TaskID that is outside this pipeline's scope, so only the numeric TaskID is carried as custom.

functions.description: record parsing scope and the TaskName join gap
batch-rename the status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target columns that need no computation, including the table-only Node/NominalStart/SourceStamp/DestFilenameOnly/DestFileID

set _time from LogStamp, convert both transfer-leg durations to nanoseconds, fold ErrCode into event.outcome while retaining the numeric code, tag the dataset's single event.category, and drop consumed raw fields
